description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the PasswordStrengthService in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for methods related to password policy enforcement, validation, URL validation, user name retrieval by reset code, and logging password enforce requests.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PasswordStrengthService functionalities in the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializes the PasswordStrengthService instance, loads fixture data, and configures mock services.

methods.name: testGetEnforcePasswordDao
methods.description: Tests that getEnforcePasswordDao returns an instance of EnforcePasswordDao.

methods.name: testCheckPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Verifies password policy checks return expected messages for given credentials.

methods.name: testIsValidPassword
methods.description: Checks if the password validation method correctly assesses password validity according to policies.

methods.name: testLogPasswordEnforceRequest
methods.description: Tests the logging function for password enforce requests.

methods.name: testValidateUrl
methods.description: Validates that the URL validation function correctly handles given URLs.

methods.name: testGetUserNameByResetCode
methods.description: Verifies that the method retrieves correct usernames based on reset codes.

methods.name: testSaveEnforcedPassword
methods.description: Tests saving enforced passwords for users and handles success/failure scenarios.
